{{- /* Every folded API reference member's URL -> its section on the parent symbol's page (api-page-url.html), for api-member-links.html: a link to a member, from a guide or from another symbol's page, goes to the section: the member has no page of its own (`build.render: link`). Call it once per build: partialCached "api-member-urls.html" site. Returns a dict: member RelPermalink -> section URL (RelPermalink#anchor). */ -}} {{- $s := newScratch -}} {{- range where site.RegularPages "Params.folded" true -}} {{- $s.SetInMap "urls" .RelPermalink (partial "api-page-url.html" .) -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($s.Get "urls" | default dict) -}}
